title: A Christmas Angel Match
overview: Christmas angels used to working alone to bring “destined soulmates together” over the holidays, are unexpectedly paired; soon, their “clashing styles – and the undeniable spark growing between them – complicate their mission.”

title: A Keller Christmas Vacation

title: A Make or Break Holiday

overview: An overwhelmed doctor is left to look after and care for three very pregnant women by herself during a storm on Christmas Eve, until she is joined by an intriguing colleague.

When Daniella and Amelia are set up by their parents, they agree to pretend that they are dating, to appease them for the holidays.
